from scipy.signal import find_peaks,savgol_filter
from trace_puzzle import im,l,r,labels,lx,rx
S=im[:,:,0].astype(float)
for mode in ('l','r'):
 v=l if mode=='l' else r
 x0,x1=(365,598) if mode=='l' else (3280,3500)
 x=np.arange(x0,x1)
 out=[]

  # Small local geometry changes follow the ridge center.
  a=a-savgol_filter(a,41,3)
  N=8192
  p=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(a*np.hanning(len(a)),N))
  f=np.fft.rfftfreq(N)
  pix=np.flatnonzero((f>.08)&(f<.4))
  peaks=find_peaks(p)[0]
  peaks=peaks[np.isin(peaks,pix)]
  tops=sorted(peaks,key=lambda z:-p[z])[:3]
  out.append((labels[i] if mode=='l' else i+1,[(round(1/f[j],3),round(p[j],0)) for j in tops]))
 print(mode)
 print(out)
